none: PAS CAM-F5DE7C: Roman Coin : Copper-alloy (probably) barbarous radiate, c.AD 275-285 copying Divus Claudius
contea di ritrovamento: City of Peterborough (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper-alloy (probably) barbarous radiate, c.AD 275-285 copying Divus Claudius (c. AD 270-271), (Reece period 14). Reverse legend reads [CONSECRA]TIO. Reverse shows an Eagle left, head turned right. Mint is uncertain. Obverse legend is illegible. Obverse shows a radiate head right. Die axis is 11 o'clock. Weight is 2.36g, diameter is 17.5mm, thickness is 1.8mm
